title: The Atlas Six
author: Olivie Blake
description: The Alexandrian Society is a secret society of magical academicians. Every decade, six uniquely talented magicians are selected for initiation, but only five will survive the year.
tropes: Dark Academia|Enemies to Lovers|Secret Society|Found Family

title: The Midnight Library
author: Matt Haig
description: Between life and death there is a library where shelves go on forever. Every book provides a chance to try another life you could have lived. Nora Seed must search within herself to decide what is truly fulfilling.

title: Sea of Tranquility
author: Emily St. John Mandel
description: A virtuous violin riff echoed across centuries connects an exiled British son in 1912, an author touring an apocalyptic earth in 2203, and a lunar detective investigating an anomaly in the forest.

title: A Dowry of Blood
author: S.T. Gibson
description: A lyrical and dark epistolary retelling of Dracula's brides, exploring the toxic web of obsession, romance, and rebellion under the roof of an immortal tyrant.

title: The Wishing Game
author: Meg Shaffer
description: Years ago, a solitary genius author hid golden tickets in his final masterwork. Now, four desperate contestants arrive on his private island for a whimsical, high-stakes game that could change their lives.
